description: MAPA 06/2024. Achat de divers matériels de télécommunication en 5 lots sur 2 ans is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Commune de Brignoles. The purpose of this consultation is to purchase telecommunications equipment with installation services in certain cases. This contract is concluded without a minimum amount and with a maximum order amount, without reopening competition when the order forms are awarded for each lot. Coverage: Commune de Brignoles. The portal shows the English title as "MAPA 06/2024. Purchase of various telecommunications equipment in 5 lots over 2 years" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Commune de Brignoles. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2024-06-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
